newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai bourse resumes Land and House trading.
newsitem.headline: Thai bourse resumes Land and House trading.

text.p: The Stock Exchange of Thailand said on Tuesday it would allow trading to resume in shares of property firm Land and House Plc at 11.45 a.m. (0445 GMT).
The exchange halted trade at the open on Tuesday pending disclosure of material information from the company.

Land and House then announced it would issue up to three billion baht in five-year debentures and 185.75 million common shares. It said it would use proceeds to finance new projects and repay short-term loans.
After the resumption shares were down 9.50 baht at a new year low of 88.50 baht. ($1 = 26 baht)
